Implemented the AWS SDK upgrade compatibility changes without modifying test files.

Updated `github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2` to `v1.23.0`, aligned related AWS service modules with compatible patch versions, wired custom IAM/STS endpoints through `BaseEndpoint`, and made web identity STS calls use anonymous credentials as required for unsigned `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` requests.
